title: PotterworldMC
description: Welcome to PotterworldMC - an open world multiplayer server set in the wizarding world of minecraft!
body:
# ✨ Welcome to PotterworldMC! ✨

Potterworld is an open-world multiplayer server set in the wizarding world of Minecraft! Come and learn spells, battle dark wizards and magical creatures, delve into dungeons, compete in minigames, duel your friends, and more! Create your own wizarding adventure at PotterworldMC!
</br>
</br>

When you join, you will begin your journey as a newcomer student going to the Hogsworth School of Witchcraft and Wizardry. Then, you will undergo a sorting ceremony to be sorted into one of the four Houses: Griffin, Honeybadger, Raven, and Serpent. After that, your adventure will be up to you — whether you are an explorer navigating through the spacious world and searching out unique magical creatures, a potioneer, an avid flier on a broom, or an exceptional student in class!
</br>
</br>

### Potterworld is proud to offer a wide range of gameplay options, including:
> 📚 Live classes, challenges and expeditions hosted by real people!
> 
> 🪄 Magic in Minecraft - no mods required, just log on and get your very own wand, broom, warp key and more!
> 
> 🏠 Personal housing plot to create your own wizarding household!
> 
> 🎮 A wide range of minigames, including player-favourites like Hide and Seek, Party Games and Melting Floor!
> 
> 🦉 A range of cosmetic items, including pets, customisable wand appearances, emotes, hats, and more!
> 
> 🔎 Open world exploration, including custom quests and storylines throughout the world!
> 
> 🗓️ Seasonal event content in a wide range of magical realms, including our annual Winter Waltz at another Magical School!

</br>
</br>
